title: setupSeccomp: avoid a cast that we don't need to do
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind cleanup

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

We don't need to cast a slice of bytes to a string to pass to LoadProfile(), when there's a LoadProfileFromBytes() that we can call instead.
